$comment: Building table per docs/09-buildings-construction.md (approved 2026-11-22). Abstract-slot buildings (Phase 2a): no map position. cost whole units, deducted upfront at build confirmation; progressCost in progress-points, builders add 1/tick (60 t/s). 'hosts' + 'slots': which role may have workers here once complete. 'requires': an id of a building TYPE whose instance must be complete before this type is buildable (only meaningful when startUnlocked=false). 'grantsTier': town tier granted on first completion (highest completed wins; tier content lands with the tiers phase). 'capacityBonus': resource -> whole units added to the base cap in economy.json.
